title: Editable conversion and loss records
prompt: Read-only reasoning exercise. Do not change files, install software or claim execution. A converter emits a Mermaid flowchart from a draw.io sequence model and skips compressed pages. The result drops activation bars and groups. A PNG of another diagram has no embedded model data. The author claims both conversions are fully editable lossless roundtrips. Diagnose the claims and specify delivery evidence.

checks.reason: Advisory routing signal only; use the rubric to judge decisions rather than keyword presence.

rubric: Record preserved, approximated, flattened, dropped and unverified semantics, identity, grouping, geometry, assets and metadata as relevant.
Retain the original when the target cannot express meaning; do not claim arbitrary roundtrip fidelity.
Distinguish embedded model extraction from uncertain visual reconstruction; PNG pixels alone do not recover the original editable graph.
acceptance: The response makes justified format-aware decisions, preserves human work and states discriminating checks and evidence limits. Static checks and reasoning do not prove actual editor or exporter behavior.
